rules.utility: South Carolina Public Service Authority (Santee Cooper)
rules.threshold_text: Mandatory for data centers with aggregate monthly maximum demand greater than 50,000 kW (50 MW), for mobile or portable data processing loads (including cryptocurrency mining) greater than 1,000 kW, and for other high load factor facilities greater than 50,000 kW that do not meet economic development rate criteria
rules.contract_term: Initial term of service of not less than 180 months (15 years); no contract demand reduction effective before 15 years of service; reductions on at least one year's written notice, limited to the greater of 10,000 kW or 20 percent in the first year, rising by steps to 100 percent from the fifth year; the schedule itself is experimental and available no later than 24 April 2029
rules.collateral: At signing, collateral or financial assurances equal to the first 180 months of Minimum Bills, at least 12 months of it as a cash deposit and the rest as credit facilities, parental guarantees or other assurances acceptable to the Authority, recalculated yearly to all outstanding Minimum Bills; before signing, the customer pays in full all delivery point and transmission costs (interconnection, network upgrades, additional or redundant facilities)

rules.utility: South Carolina Public Service Authority (Santee Cooper)
rules.threshold_text: Mandatory for data centers with aggregate monthly maximum demand greater than 20,000 kW (20 MW), for mobile or portable data processing loads (including cryptocurrency mining) greater than 1,000 kW, and for other high load factor facilities greater than 20,000 kW that do not meet economic development rate criteria (lowered from 50,000 kW under L-25-LL)
rules.contract_term: Initial term of service of not less than 180 months (15 years); no contract demand reduction effective before 15 years of service; reductions on at least one year's written notice, limited to the greater of 4,000 kW or 20 percent in the first year, rising by steps to 100 percent from the fifth year
rules.collateral: At signing, collateral or financial assurances equal to the first 180 months of Minimum Bills, at least 12 months of it as a cash deposit; the rest by a creditworthiness matrix: a guaranty may cover up to 100 percent for a customer or guarantor rated Aaa to A3 (Moody's) or AAA to A- (S&P or Fitch), while Baa1 or BBB+ or lower, or no rating, requires 100 percent letter of credit or cash; recalculated yearly to all outstanding Minimum Bills. Before signing, the customer pays in full all delivery point and transmission costs, with possible later credits if other customers benefit
